"A cinematic, first-person gameplay  mobile open-world action-adventure game with the exact visual style, interface, and lighting of Grand Theft Auto V, but featuring a skateboarding mechanic, captured as if shown on a modern smartphone screen. 

The scene is set on a sunny, bustling, palm-tree-lined boulevard in a Los Santos-inspired city with heavy traffic, urban buildings, and distant hills. In the center, a male protagonist wearing a dark zip-up hoodie, dark jeans, and skate sneakers is actively riding a worn, graphic-decorated skateboard down the middle of the asphalt. He is leaning forward, carving, with one foot on the board and body angled as if coasting at speed. In the background, a police cruiser with flashing blue and red sirens is actively pursuing him alongside other vehicles. 

The image must include a dense, transparent mobile game HUD (heads-up display) overlay:
- Top-Left: A circular radar mini-map showing roads and a player icon, with small horizontal status bars underneath (health, armor, stamina in green, blue, and yellow) alongside a small heart, shield, and lightning bolt icon.
- Top-Right: Cash display showing \"$1,413,892\" in green, a weapon icon (micro SMG) labelled \"micro SMG\", and a wanted level of 2 out of 5 stars (gold/red stars).
- Bottom-Left: A large, semi-transparent virtual d-pad/analog joystick for movement.
- Bottom-Right: A cluster of touch-screen action buttons specifically for skateboarding, labeled: \"PUSH\" (with a shoe/kick icon), \"OLLIE\" (with a jumping skateboarder icon), \"TRICK\" (with circular rotation arrow icon), and \"DISMOUNT\" (with a stepping-off-the-board icon), alongside standard GTA mobile controls like \"SHOOT\" (crosshair), \"CAMERA\" (video camera icon), and sprinting buttons.
- Bottom Center: The objective text \"LOSE THE POLICE\" in yellow.

The view has realistic 3D game graphics with motion blur, sun glare, and dust on the road, with the entire interface framed by the subtle edge of a landscape-oriented smartphone bezel.

---

## Objective

- Implement the game directly in the existing project without asking clarifying questions.
